name: @sos-2/event-ingestion
description: SOS 2.0 Event Ingestion (Work Order P7): the Observation Plane ingestion boundary. Normalizes the §5 input families (GitHub repository/webhook events, CI/build/test/security events, deployment events, runtime telemetry, incidents/provider health, scheduled probes, explicit user observations) into P2 replay-protected observation events through typed source adapters. EVERY event carries a delivery id; duplicates are answered with the typed DUPLICATE outcome from the durable P2 store — never double-applied. Payloads are OPAQUE canonical-JSON preserved verbatim (truth states inside payloads survive ingestion bit-exact and are never folded into success or zero). Scheduled probes are first-class but HONEST about being fallback: the coverage ledger reports where event/telemetry coverage is insufficient, and probes are only due where a real gap exists (the work-order behavior rule). Source health is tracked per source (last event, outcome counts, poll failures) with no hidden clocks (injected Clock everywhere) and zero ambient network/process/time in package src — real provider endpoints attach later as adapters; the package never fabricates their evidence.
